SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, calendar_year, fiscal_quarter
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_year IN (2024, 2025, 2026)
ORDER BY calendar_year, fiscal_quarter

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(period_start_date) as q_start, MAX(period_end_date) as q_end
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter

-- Get stores that were open in both Q3 periods
WITH q3_fy2425 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude online (900)
),
q3_fy2526 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude online (900)
)
SELECT q1.store_id, q1.region
FROM q3_fy2425 q1
INNER JOIN q3_fy2526 q2 ON q1.store_id = q2.store_id
ORDER BY q1.region, q1.store_id

-- Calculate LFL sales by region for Q3 FY2024/25 vs FY2025/26
-- First, identify stores that were open in both periods
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
),
-- Q3 FY2024/25 sales for LFL stores
q3_fy2425_sales AS (
  SELECT lfl.region, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales_q3_2425
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY lfl.region
),
-- Q3 FY2025/26 sales for LFL stores
q3_fy2526_sales AS (
  SELECT lfl.region, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales_q3_2526
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY lfl.region
)
SELECT 
  q1.region,
  q1.net_sales_q3_2425,
  q2.net_sales_q3_2526,
  ROUND(((q2.net_sales_q3_2526 - q1.net_sales_q3_2425) / q1.net_sales_q3_2425 * 100), 2) as growth_pct
FROM q3_fy2425_sales q1
JOIN q3_fy2526_sales q2 ON q1.region = q2.region
ORDER BY q1.region

-- Check if returns should be netted from sales
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as return_count,
  SUM(refund_net) as total_refunds
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
  OR return_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'

-- Calculate LFL net sales (after returns) by region for Q3 FY2024/25 vs FY2025/26
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
),
-- Q3 FY2024/25 sales for LFL stores (net of returns)
q3_fy2425_sales AS (
  SELECT lfl.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY lfl.region
),
-- Q3 FY2025/26 sales for LFL stores (net of returns)
q3_fy2526_sales AS (
  SELECT lfl.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY lfl.region
)
SELECT 
  q1.region,
  ROUND(q1.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_q3_2425,
  ROUND(q2.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_q3_2526,
  ROUND(((q2.net_sales - q1.net_sales) / q1.net_sales * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM q3_fy2425_sales q1
JOIN q3_fy2526_sales q2 ON q1.region = q2.region
ORDER BY q1.region

-- Check for store closures during the Q3 periods
SELECT 
  store_id,
  closure_start_date,
  closure_end_date,
  weeks_closed
FROM ref_store_closure
WHERE (closure_start_date <= '2025-01-26' AND closure_end_date >= '2024-10-28')
   OR (closure_start_date <= '2026-01-25' AND closure_end_date >= '2025-10-27')
ORDER BY store_id, closure_start_date

-- Check staff purchases in the Q3 periods
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as staff_purchase_lines,
  SUM(net_amount) as staff_purchase_value
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE staff_purchase_flag = TRUE
  AND (sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    OR sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25')

-- Calculate LFL net sales (after returns, excluding staff purchases) by region for Q3 FY2024/25 vs FY2025/26
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
)
SELECT 
  region,
  COUNT(*) as num_stores
FROM lfl_stores
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

-- Q3 FY2024/25 sales for LFL stores (net of returns, excluding staff purchases)
q3_fy2425_sales AS (
